title: An Odyssey Through Space and The Endless Sea of Stars
author: AffectionateTwo658
selftext:
So let me preface this by saying im not a huge fan of AI.  I do use it occasionally, and paid the 20 bucks for notebooklm for its podcast feature.

All that being said, I write analog games and put them up on itch.io, as downloadable PDF files for free.  I got the update for Argon, and made the chessboard and was actually kind of impressed with the simplicity.  So I started generating a few games that I wrote.  Then I started prompting this one and just... kept going.  It didn't generate the whole game all at once, and I used over half of my weekly usage over about 3 days.  And this is the result.

What do you think?  Ai is in a pretty interesting place that I can write a game for analog play, and then prompt it into existence via vibe coding.

I generated the game in chunks rather than all at once.  It wrote the game, but unfinished, and then i learned its more efficient to just keep generating chunks of updates and have it show me where to copy and paste them myself.  It makes me want to take an HTML course because its quite interesting.

Link to game in the white box, its all text.
